svg.title: TR2 at each fixed separated shape, with its fixed-distance logarithm, gives normalized trace limit cG|x1 −x2|−8. Divide by the square of TR91’s nonzero limiting coefficient to get the free scalar limit for ws. The uncentered unit remainder gives ms = O(s4/|ds|) →0, since s4 log(1/s) →0. Unit insertion gives ⟨vs(sx1)vs(sx2)⟩χ = ⟨ws(sx1)ws(sx2)⟩χ + m2 s, (TR92)
